purpose: Frozen evidence lineage for provenance and design history. Only the final Stage-6 fresh-cohort experiment is used for the main-paper inference.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-I Stage 1B - task-relevant dimension control
canonical_evidence.key_result: Reproducible d=1 geometry but poor/negative held-out predictive sufficiency.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-I Stage 1C - objective-conflict pilot
canonical_evidence.key_result: Promising effect size; inferential confirmation insufficient.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-I Stage 2P - architecture preflight
canonical_evidence.key_result: Common ResNet/ViT support established; no architecture-response transport claim.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-I Stage 2Q - architecture preflight
canonical_evidence.key_result: Common ResNet/ViT support established; no architecture-response transport claim.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-II RC11 Stage 01
canonical_evidence.key_result: Discovery/preflight evidence; crosses documented adoption boundary before Stage 02.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-II RC11 Stage 04 - pressure-emergence confirmation
canonical_evidence.key_result: Manipulation worked, but pressure did not cause predictive-state emergence; clean learning showed strongest state-like organization.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-II Stage 06 RC13B - predictive susceptibility decomposition parent
canonical_evidence.key_result: Stopped prospectively on Q-support geometry failure at proposed task 3127; preserved as parent evidence.

canonical_evidence.label: NEXUS-II Stage 06 RC13C - final confirmation completion
canonical_evidence.key_result: Between-task phenotype false; within-task causal state false; optimizer anisotropy true. This is the main-paper evidence.
